about: Sources for the captured toys. tools/prepare-assets.mjs turns each into assets/toys/<id>/<id>.sog (and a lighter <id>-lite.sog for weak devices). Licences and credits are in CREDITS.md.

toys.label: Pencil
toys.sourceNote: Made by tools/image-to-3d.mjs (TRELLIS, seed 1) from the CC BY 2.0 photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kleiner_Bleistift_(40045317711).jpg by Tim Reckmann, resized to 1024 px: node tools/image-to-3d.mjs <photo.png> --name=pencil-1. After packing, node tools/g-looks.mjs pencil-real --all paints the yellow pencil look and the other looks (pencil-real-<look>.sog).

toys.label: Tin can
toys.sourceNote: Made by tools/image-to-3d.mjs (TRELLIS, seed 1) from the CC0 photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Can_opened_with_side_opener.jpg by Ll1324, resized to 1024 px: node tools/image-to-3d.mjs <photo.png> --name=soup-can-1. After packing, node tools/g-looks.mjs tin-can-real --all wraps on the peaches label and writes the other looks (tin-can-real-<look>.sog; the labels are original CC0 designs drawn by that tool).

photoSamples.name: Forest Away Path
photoSamples.author: Seaq68 (from Pixabay, 2017)
photoSamples.note: Marked CC0 on its Wikimedia Commons page. Reduced to 1,280 px wide by Commons. Its depth map is made by tools/p3d-depth.mjs.

photoSamples.name: Carleton Street off Leeman Road, York
photoSamples.author: Malcolmxl5
photoSamples.note: Own work, CC0 on its Wikimedia Commons page. Reduced to 1,280 px wide by Commons. Its depth map is made by tools/p3d-depth.mjs.

photoSamples.name: Still Life with Cheese
photoSamples.author: Antoine Vollon (Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access)
photoSamples.note: A painting in the public domain, CC0 from the Met's Open Access program on its Wikimedia Commons page. Reduced to 1,280 px wide by Commons. Its depth map is made by tools/p3d-depth.mjs.

depthModel.name: Depth Anything V2 Small (quantized ONNX)
depthModel.author: Lihe Yang et al. (Depth Anything V2); ONNX conversion by onnx-community
depthModel.note: 27,258,801 bytes. Base model https://huggingface.co/depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small (Apache-2.0; the Base, Large and Giant sizes are CC BY-NC and are not used). Loaded only when someone opens a photo in the Photo to 3D toy.

depthRuntime.name: ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0 (WebAssembly build)
depthRuntime.author: Microsoft
depthRuntime.note: ort.wasm.min.mjs, ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs and ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm from the npm package onnxruntime-web@1.30.0, unmodified. Loaded only when someone opens a photo in the Photo to 3D toy.
